caption_L2L3: Bar 2012-2013, Infiniti car sales increased from 2010 to 2017. Infiniti car sales peaked in 2017, with around 3,500 units sold. There was a steep drop in sales from 2017 to 2018. The drop in sales continued from 2018 to 2019, but at a slightly slower rate.
